_note: Real source. Every literal_gloss and quotation is verbatim from the 1933 print (original orthography kept; […] marks omitted list items), checked against the page images of the ZBC scan, not only its OCR. Locators give the printed page and the scan's PDF page. Formation types map Buryan's own section headings: 1 z imion → OTHER, odojcowskie → PATRONYMIC, 3 przydomki → DESCRIPTIVE, 4 zatrudnienie → OCCUPATIONAL, 5 narodowość → OTHER, 6 siedzibowe → TOPONYMIC. Root forms only where Buryan names the base himself.

licence_basis.reason: Author Józef Buryan (1883–1950) died in 1950 (Zielonogórska Biblioteka Cyfrowa record oai:zbc.uz.zgora.pl:82526). Economic rights expire 70 years after the author's death, counted from the end of that year (Polish Copyright Act, art. 36), so the work has been in the public domain since 2021-01-01. The 1933 notice 'Wszelkie prawa zastrzeżone' lapsed with those rights.
